analyst.summary: Jana Small Finance Bank is recovering well from the microfinance-sector stress of the past couple of years -- profit, margins, and loan growth are all improving, asset quality is getting better each quarter, and the bank has deliberately shifted its loan mix toward secured lending to reduce future volatility. Valuation remains reasonable for the improving trend. We rate this a Hold: real progress, but the bank is still proving out a turnaround from a stressed base rather than showing a long, clean track record.
